content: MediaStore insert workflow on Android 10+: build ContentValues with DISPLAY_NAME, RELATIVE_PATH (e.g. Music/AppName), MIME_TYPE, and IS_PENDING=1; insert() into MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI to get a content:// Uri; open OutputStream via that Uri and write audio bytes; then update ContentValues with IS_PENDING=0 to finalize and make the file visible/queryable by other apps.
